variation.scope: Tie spacing relaxed, 20 to 15 ties, all lifts

notes.inspector_remark: Toe boards on lifts 4-7 replaced and rechecked.

deciding.design_conformity: The only departure is ties_fitted 15 against 20 required, and variation V-17 approved by the TW coordinator explicitly covers that tie reduction on all lifts. Height and lifts match.
deciding.handover_decision: Drawing refs agree, tie test passed, cert signed, card valid, and the single defect is closed and reinspected, so nothing is outstanding.
deciding.limiting_issue: The toe-board defect on lifts 4-7 is closed and rechecked, so none_found is plausible, but it was a recorded component defect, so component_defect also stands. The two are held in balance.
deciding.discrepancy_size: Ties fitted 15 against 20 required is exactly 25% short, on the level 2/3 boundary. The approved variation does not change the size of the gap.
deciding.releasable_share: The defect on lifts 4-7 (4 of 11 lifts) is closed and reinspected, so most readers would release everything. A residual doubt about those lifts leaves some room for level 2.
